title: Stacks
definition: A stack is a Last-In-First-Out (LIFO) linear data structure.
intuition: Like a stack of plates: the last one placed is the first one removed.
how_it_works: Operations are restricted to one end: push adds, pop removes, peek views.
when_to_use: For backtrack tracking, matching brackets, evaluation, and depth-first search.
when_not_to_use: When random access or FIFO behavior is required.
content: A stack is a Last-In-First-Out (LIFO) linear data structure.
